note: Pre-registration BEFORE the census run (claims JSON sha256+mtime sealed in receipts/45e-claims-registration.json). Registered_at timestamp above is nominal; the authoritative registration time is the mtime+sha receipt. No census process job had been submitted at registration time (hands-on budget 10/10 was already closed).
census_design: N=3 engines x 1 job each (emu), small shots; raw bitstream per engine -> registered mothbits whitening (von Neumann -> sha256 counter stream -> Fisher-Yates, pool 1134 take 16) -> balance + sha receipts; markdown verdict comparing engines.

job_budget.retry_rule: the single retry is spent only if a job 422s with a 'missing property' error, and is retried with engine defaults ({}); both attempts receipted

claims.claim: TOP-20 TRUNCATION: graph-v1 returns at most 20 distinct outcomes in its measurements multiset when theoretical support (2^12 = 4096 for num_qubits=12) exceeds 20; evidence = measurements.length <= 20 AND sum(measurements.count) < requested shots (1024).
claims.falsifier: FAIL if graph-v1 returns > 20 distinct outcomes, or returns sum(count) == shots with > 20 distinct outcomes.

claims.claim: WHITENED BALANCE: every census engine yielding >= 64 raw bits (expected: comet-qrng-v1 raw randomness register, graph-v1 count-expanded measurement stream) whitens through the registered mothbits recipe to ones/length in [0.45, 0.55] over the counter-stream bytes consumed by the Fisher-Yates draws.
claims.falsifier: FAIL if any such engine's whitened balance falls outside [0.45, 0.55].

claims.claim: CATALOG: the instrument's read-only catalog survey returns the same visible-engine count as the manual step-1 survey receipt (33 engines @ 2026-09-27) and that set is a strict superset of the 13 engines in the archived 2026-09-25 docs (v0.41.0).
claims.falsifier: FAIL if the count differs from 33, or any archived-docs engine is absent from the live catalog.

claims.claim: CERTIFIED-RANDOM LEG: comet-qrng-v1 (emu, bell_witness=false, num_qubits=12) passes its own health gate (entropy_report.health_passed === true) and its platform Toeplitz-extracted bits have ones/length in [0.45, 0.55].
claims.falsifier: FAIL if health_passed is false, or extracted balance outside [0.45, 0.55], or no extracted bytes returned for output_bytes=512 requested.

claims.claim: COUNTS-ONLY ENGINE: coin-toss-v1 returns aggregate counts ONLY (heads/tails, no >= 16-bit bitstring payload anywhere in the result), i.e. it cannot feed the seed pipeline without a counts->bits convention; its whitening leg is honestly N/A.
claims.falsifier: FAIL if coin-toss-v1's result contains a >= 16-char 0/1 bitstring or >= 32-char hex payload.

order_of_operations: 2. optional deepseek-reasoner BLIND prediction (engine descriptions only, no hands-on balances leaked) - before any census job
3. census run (the only process jobs after registration)
